verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Balances API for real-time and historical balance data, aimed at bookkeeping. Its MCP server exposes both the Balances API and a Settlements API to AI agents. Per-payout breakdown of transactions, fees and deductions is documented for the Settlement Report, but the evidence does not show that this deposit-to-charges mapping is available via API. Missing for 10: documented API-level balance-transaction listing linking each settlement/payout to its underlying payments, explicit Settlements API reconciliation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: The Balances API allows you to retrieve real-time as well as historical information about your Mollie balance. This may be useful to for example integrate Mollie into your bookkeeping.
Settlement Report gives you a complete breakdown of the data included in a specific payout. It shows all transactions, fees and deductions that are part of a single settlement.

Currently, the following APIs are available: Balances API, Captures API, Customers API, Invoices API, Mandates API, Methods API, Payments API, Payment Links API, Settlements API, Subscriptions API, Terminals API, Webhooks API, Webhook Events API.
